top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a complete, independently replicated discovery chain (proglucagon processing, the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, glucose-dependent insulin secretion, central and gastric effects) that now underlies therapies with glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal benefit in large outcome trials. Drucker, Holst and Mojsov cover secretion and physiology, mechanism and translational proof of concept, and identification and synthesis of the active peptide, so allocation and citation scope fit a discovery prize. No award is clearly inferior given this maturity.
